info.title: Renice
info.description: Catalog, cart and orders of the Renice store. Authenticate with a bearer token from `POST /api/v1/tokens`; tokens carry the `read` and/or `write` scopes and expire after 30 days. Money is in integer cents (BRL).

get.description:
The customer's saved addresses; one of them is the `address_id` for
placing an order. Addresses are managed in the store's account area.

post.description:
Adding a product already in the cart increases its quantity. The
quantity is checked against stock.

get.description: The customer's orders, newest first; 10 per page.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.description:
Turns the cart into an order, reserves the stock until
`payment_due_at` and creates the Pix charge. If the payment provider is
unavailable, the order is still placed and `payment` is null; the
customer can pay from the store's order page. Requires a confirmed
e-mail.

get.description:
With its items, timeline and Pix payment. While the order waits for
payment, `payment.pix_code` and `payment.pix_qr_image` are what the
customer pays with.

The same catalog as the store: search across name and description,
sorting, and an "available only" filter; 12 per page.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.description:
Exchanges the account's e-mail and password for a bearer token. Accounts
with two-factor authentication also need the current `code`: a token
must not be a way around the second factor. Limited to 5 attempts per
minute per e-mail and IP.

token.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer {token}`. Shown only once.

device_name.description: Shown in the account to tell tokens apart, e.g. "Integração ERP".

code.description: Required when the account has two-factor authentication on: the 6-digit code from the app.

payment_due_at.description: Until when the stock is reserved; only while waiting for payment.

pix_code.description: Pix "copia e cola", only while the charge can be paid.

pix_qr_image.description: QR code image as a data URI, only while the charge can be paid.

OrderStatus.description: Order lifecycle. The transitions below are the only ones allowed; ChangeOrderStatus enforces them and records each one in the timeline.
OrderStatus.title: OrderStatus

PaymentStatus.description: Status of a Pix charge, as the payment provider reports it.
PaymentStatus.title: PaymentStatus

PlaceOrderRequest.description:
The only input checkout takes is which of the customer's own addresses to
ship to. The cart is resolved from the authenticated user: v1 took a cart
id from the URL and interpolated it into SQL (SEC-02).
PlaceOrderRequest.title: PlaceOrderRequest

rating.description: Average rating from 1 to 5, or null without reviews.

UpdateCartItemRequest.description:
Quantity must be a positive whole number within available stock. v1
accepted anything, including zero and negative values (SEC-03).
UpdateCartItemRequest.title: UpdateCartItemRequest

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
